content.body: bakkot: I'd like us to make progress on the sync callback motivation. I still can't picture an example (besides easier compatibility with existing code), where you cannot structure the code to check the aborted state if you need to not wait for an async callback. I've opened https://github.com/tc39/proposal-cancellation/issues/36. Since we're adding a new way to register callbacks anyway, I really think those should be async.
